records.title: Archived Claude Code conversation identified as the primary MBC6Test history
records.content: The project owner identified and the authenticated browser session confirmed this Claude Code session as the primary MBC6Test conversation. Its hosted conversation was reviewed for durable project memory; the raw transcript was not copied into OMM. Related local continuation logs 81880153-b86e-4d1e-a605-e1fe9c128d91 and 95f4383e-23d6-4be5-a216-b2ecaba1e0c6 contain compacted summaries and later exchanges, but are not assumed to be a complete copy of the hosted session.
evidence: Claude Code session visually inspected in authenticated browser on 2026-10-01

records.title: MBC6Test changes require genuine runtime evidence and readable results
records.content: The project owner rejected treating a successful build as sufficient validation and required real runtime testing. Test outcomes must be human-readable on-screen, including a result grid, failure-detail view, and INFO view, rather than only a one-line summary. Keep static verification and runtime mapper evidence distinct.

records.title: Keep emulator gaps separate from normative MBC6 expectations
records.content: Historical implementation work cross-checked behavior against GBE+ and mGBA while preserving emulator limitations as emulator-specific evidence. Do not change normative test expectations to accommodate an emulator gap; identify the emulator and version and report that gap separately. BGB was not treated as a usable MBC6 runtime oracle in that work.

records.title: Release builds are manual GitHub Actions runs with traceable build IDs
records.content: The owner chose a manually triggered GitHub Actions release workflow, with a seven-character commit hash as the release tag and the same build identifier displayed in the ROM title/results UI. Builds should not publish automatically on every push. Gitea is a backup mirror, not the release destination.

records.title: Publish and verify both safe and explicitly destructive configurations
records.content: The default build keeps destructive flash tests disabled. The manual release pipeline also builds and verifies an explicitly enabled destructive configuration and publishes it as a separately named, clearly labeled asset. Keep the default safe ROM and destructive ROM distinguishable in both artifact name and release description.

records.title: The linked Am29F400 datasheet is analogous, not the MBC6 cartridge flash datasheet
records.content: The historical discussion clarified that the datasheet linked from the NP GB Memory research page is for AMD/Spansion Am29F400, not the Macronix MX29F008TC/ATC used in the cartridge. It was not the implementation authority; the work relied on the iceboy reverse-engineering notes and cross-checks against hardware tools. Treat command similarities as cross-check context, not proof that the two flash parts are identical.

records.title: Keep MBC6 communication in Brazilian Portuguese and require explicit commit or push requests
records.content: The project owner established Brazilian Portuguese as the conversation language. The historical workflow also required explicit user direction before committing or pushing changes; preserve that project-specific preference when working in the MBC6Test repository.
